propositions: The macOS pytest cell (_build-and-test.yml test job default-suite step) runs --cov coverage collection taking 15.4m of 18.6m total job time, but the result is never consumed since ubuntu cells enforce the same fail_under=70 floor identically.

The macOS runner concurrency is capped (peak 4 concurrent observed), causing later changes to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for a slot, turning single runs into 41-47m wall-clock when the critical-path macOS job alone takes 18.6m.

Removing --cov and --cov-report flags from macOS matrix cells preserves test execution (identical 7856 test selection) and coverage enforcement (three ubuntu cells) while eliminating redundant tracing overhead.
The coverage flags must be conditionally applied per-OS using startsWith(matrix.os, 'macos') negation logic to avoid GitHub Actions silent no-op behavior with empty string branches.
